metaTitle: Custom Safety Lanyards Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom safety lanyards and badges for your team. High-visibility colors and imprint options. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Safety lanyards and badges use high-visibility colors like neon yellow or orange to ensure your employees and their credentials are easy to spot. Ideal for construction sites, warehouses, or event staff, these lanyards help enforce safety protocols while keeping IDs accessible. Choose from breakaway clasps or badge reels, and add your logo with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation for clear branding that stands out in busy environments.
heroAltText: Custom safety lanyards and badges in neon yellow and orange with logo imprint, featuring breakaway clasps and badge holders.
